basis.note: One objective per high-school performance expectation. The PE statements were read; the evidence statements were not. Drills for PEs taught elsewhere are drawn from the subject frameworks; the engineering and design PEs have their own items.

big_ideas.title: Performance expectations are practices applied to core ideas
big_ideas.text: Each PE pairs a science or engineering practice with a disciplinary core idea and a crosscutting concept. A drill isolates the reasoning step; the full practice (designing, investigating, arguing) happens away from the card.

practices.title: Use mathematics and computational thinking
practices.text: Carry a model to a number and judge it.

practices.title: Design and evaluate solutions
practices.text: Apply criteria, constraints and trade-offs to a design choice.
